The Ministry of Home Affairs also reduced information requirements on application forms by 65 to 70 percent, aiming to make the process more efficient for international visitors and students.

stories.title: International student enrolments drop in US and UK
stories.summary: US and UK universities are reporting declines in international undergraduate enrolments as students look toward Asia and Europe. A survey of 437 universities recorded a 13 percent fall in the US and a 19 percent decline in the UK. Demand in Canada and Australia is also weaker.

stories.title: UK student visa applications continue to decline
stories.summary: UK student visa applications dropped 20 percent in the year ending October 2026, with 5,800 applications filed last month. This represents a 31 percent fall compared to October 2025 and a 44 percent drop from October 2023. The sponsored study route continues to see fewer applicants.

stories.title: Business school decline could cost UK economy billions
stories.summary: International business school enrolments have fallen 18 percent since the UK tightened immigration measures, including a visa ban for dependents. London Economics estimates a further 30 percent drop could cost the economy 4.2 billion pounds and 32,300 jobs. The sector is currently adjusting to the new policy.

stories.title: Penn State ranked for entrepreneurship
stories.summary: Penn State placed 39th nationally for undergraduate entrepreneurship studies in the 2027 Princeton Review rankings. The assessment considered over 40 data points, including faculty credentials and mentorship. The university also secured the third spot among schools in the Mid-Atlantic region. Rankings remain a popular academic export.

stories.title: LSU Shreveport leads Louisiana online rankings
stories.summary: LSU Shreveport is the top online college in Louisiana according to Newsweek and Statista. The ranking relied on a survey of 9,000 former students and public data from the National Center of Education Statistics. Respondents evaluated institutions on criteria including price, support, and AI-related learning experiences.

stories.title: University of Arizona tops military ranking
stories.summary: The University of Arizona is the nation's best public university for service members, according to Military Times. The school took the top spot among public institutions and second overall in the 2026 Best for Vets rankings. A total of 370 universities qualified for the list.

stories.title: ASU claims research collaboration marks

stories.title: Princeton and Penn lead WalletHub rankings
stories.summary: Princeton University and the University of Pennsylvania were named the top two schools in the region by WalletHub. Rankings continue to be a primary metric for personal-finance websites.

stories.title: Danish career programme aids international students
stories.summary: A six-month career programme called Young Professionals in Denmark helped over 4,000 international students enter the local job market. The initiative, run by Copenhagen Capacity with eight universities, addressed language barriers and networking challenges. The programme was designed to retain talent for the Danish economy.

stories.title: Dutch universities see international intake rise
stories.summary: Dutch university intake rose 3.5 per cent this academic year, with international student numbers increasing by almost 6 per cent. This growth follows three years of decline and comes despite previous cabinet efforts to reduce English-taught programmes and cut budgets. The current cabinet remains less hostile to international recruitment.

The university is preparing for its 60th anniversary under new leadership.
